mapper.select: SELECT dwps.maximum maximum, d.`name` doctorName, dwps.slot slot, dwp.doctor_id doctorId, dwp.id workPlanId FROM doctor_work_plan dwp JOIN doctor_work_plan_schedule dwps ON dwp.id = dwps.work_plan_id JOIN doctor d ON dwp.doctor_id = d.id WHERE dwp.dept_sub_id = #{deptSubId} AND dwp.`date` = STR_TO_DATE('${date}', '%Y-%m-%d')

SELECT p.doctor_id AS doctorId, s.id AS scheduleId, s.slot AS slot, s.maximum AS maximum, s.num AS num, 'ACTIVE' AS scheduleStatus, DATE_FORMAT(p.date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date FROM doctor_work_plan p JOIN doctor_work_plan_schedule s ON s.work_plan_id = p.id WHERE p.id = #{workPlanId}
